summary: A clean, honest Phase 1 recreation of the Nord Stage 4 73 surface. The desktop capture (stage1-desktop.png) shows a continuous red chassis with the six sections in the correct left-to-right order (Performance, Organ, Piano, Program, Synth, Effects), dark inset panels, nine drawbars with LED ladders, and Program + Synth as the only OLED-style displays (matches the audit and hard gate). The keybed models 73 keys E-to-E (43 white / 30 black; whiteKeys length 43 in App.tsx). All panel controls are honestly presentation-only: they write only the normalized `hardware` map, displays are explicitly labeled DECORATIVE, and the footer reads '0 PRESENTATION CONTROLS'. I verified at runtime (served dist on 8751) that pressing a key created exactly one AudioContext and 3 oscillators (triangle + two sines) with status 'ready · generated piano', while dispatching input on a drawbar created zero audio nodes -- confirming the decorative boundary. Input handling is comprehensive: pointer with pointer-capture and per-pointerId source keys (multitouch), computer keyboard with repeat suppression, Web MIDI (note/velocity/note-off/CC64, statechange disconnect clears notes), space/CC64 sustain, and blur/unmount cleanup, all through one activeSources lifecycle. Voice management includes velocity, exponential release, 24-voice oldest-first stealing, and disconnect cleanup. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json truthfully declares a generated synthesis source with no recorded-sample claim. Main limitations: the geometry is a stylized simplification of the far denser reference, knobs move only by click-increment and keyboard (no pointer drag), and candidate tests assert DOM state rather than the audio boundary (jsdom has no AudioContext).

evidence: stage1-desktop.png: continuous red chassis, six ordered sections, dark inset Organ/Piano/Synth/Effects plates, deck/keybed roughly 54/46.
stage1-visual-audit.md documents source aspect ratio 3.0951, instrument width min(92vw,1450px)=~92% of 1440 viewport within 88-97% band.
Keybed models 73 keys E-to-E: App.tsx whiteKeys = Array.from({length:43}), blacks via BLACK_AFTER giving 30 -> 73 total.
Geometry is a clean but stylized simplification versus the much denser reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg.

All six sections rendered with dense controls: Organ (4 models, 9 drawbars with LED ladders, perc, vib/chorus, rotary), Piano (2 layers, 6 types, timbre, detail), Program (dial, 8 buttons, pages, Live/Scene/Store/Split, morph), Synth (2 layers, osc/filter/env/lfo/arp), Effects (focus + 4 effect groups + rotary + bypass).

Program and Synth are the only primary OLED displays; Performance/Organ/Piano/Effects have none (verified in image + audit section 'No primary OLED is rendered in Performance, Organ, Piano, or Effects').
Inventory simplified vs reference (effects collapsed into 4 columns, fewer synth params than hardware).
Red brushed chassis, dark inset panels, green OLED displays, dot-LED ladders, knob markers, Nord Stage 4 branding, small legends (stage1-desktop.png).
Section headers use eyebrow + title + ON/OFF state chips; sustain/level micro-copy present.
Materials are convincing but flatter/less photographic than the reference.
stage1-visual-audit.md: at 390px shell switches to 3x2 section grid retaining both OLEDs and all 73 keys with a 790px min height to avoid horizontal clipping.
Phase 1 has comparatively few controls so narrow retention is legible (stage3 narrow later shows crowding once controls multiply).

App.tsx routes pointer (setPointerCapture + `pointer-${pointerId}-${note}` source keys enabling multitouch), computer keyboard (COMPUTER_KEYS map, repeat suppression via heldComputerKeys), and MIDI (handleMidiMessage: 0x90/0x80/0x90-vel0/CC64) through one activeSources lifecycle.
Runtime verified: pressing 'z' created one AudioContext and a voice (3 oscillators).
MIDI failure/denied handled ('denied · MIDI permission unavailable'), statechange disconnect calls stopEverything and clears notes; blur clears all.
Pointer velocity derives from event.pressure (48 + pressure*79), which is 0/coarse on most devices; multitouch and MIDI paths verified by code only.
BasicPianoEngine.noteOn: velocity->gain, exponential attack; noteOff: 0.35s exponential release; sustain flag holds voices; 24-voice MAX with oldest-first releaseVoice steal.
releaseVoice stops oscillators and disconnects via setTimeout; dispose() closes context on unmount; blur triggers allNotesOff.
Overlap/repeat guarded by activeSources map keyed per source.
Panel controls remain decorative (verified drawbar input created 0 audio nodes).
Runtime rail status read 'ready · generated piano'; keybed caption 'GENERATED PIANO'.
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares strategy 'Generated Web Audio piano fallback', generatedSources only, sampleSources: [], 'No recording is claimed.'
Error path: getContext throws if no Web Audio -> onStatus('error', ...) while keyboard remains usable.
Dependable audible three-partial voice; no distinct loading state (synthesis is instant).
Knob: role=slider, aria-valuemin/max/now, ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right/Home/End keyboard handling, click increments +0.08, CSS --knob-angle rotation.
Fader/drawbar are range inputs with aria-labels; Toggle uses aria-pressed; wheels/pitch-stick role=slider with keyboard.
Limitation: knobs respond to click and keyboard only -- no pointer drag/rotation gesture.
All panel controls call setHardware into the normalized `hardware` map only; none touch the audio engine.
Runtime verified: dispatching input on #organ-drawbar-0 left oscillator count unchanged (0 new audio nodes).
Program and Synth displays render explicit 'DECORATIVE' text; footer shows presentation-control count; audit states no panel action claims unimplemented behavior.
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json note: 'Panel controls update normalized presentation state only; they do not alter the audio graph in Phase 1.'
Stable string IDs throughout; normalized hardware state via useHardwareState; audio isolated in BasicPianoEngine class separate from React input layer.

App.test.tsx (67 lines) covers key inventory, section order, OLED count, pointer press/release, computer-key repeat suppression, sustain/blur cleanup, accessible knob state, and MIDI availability boundary.
Tests assert DOM state only (jsdom has no AudioContext) rather than audio output.
Runtime console clean except favicon 404 (no app errors/pageErrors); stage1-capture.json consoleMessages/pageErrors empty.
Cleanup on unmount (dispose) and blur; responsive layout renders at 390 and 1440.
Repeated key interaction stable; single AudioContext reused.

issues: Piano source is generated synthesis only (honestly declared) -- acceptable for Phase 1's basic-voice scope but no recorded sample.
Knobs move only via click-increment and keyboard; no pointer drag gesture for continuous controls.
Candidate tests assert DOM/aria state, not the Web Audio backend (jsdom limitation).
Surface geometry is a stylized simplification of the substantially denser reference panel.
